title: Health Resort east wing room 213 key

infobox.usage: This key has no usage. Room 213 is always unlocked.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 213 key (E213 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 213.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 213 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 213:
  - One Weapon box (6x2)
  - One Weapon box (6x6)
  - One Medbag

- Room 209
  - One Rare Loot spawn
